captions.text: In Unit, open Maps and find the Community coordination centre under Indoor Maps.
Select that indoor entry.
The viewer opens with Ground floor selected in blue.
The row beneath the Indoor Maps heading lets you switch between this floor plan
and the department’s other saved layers.
This fictional example is for reviewing reference information with a crew.

scenes.title: Select a saved room and read its details

captions.text: On Ground floor, inspect the floor-plan image and the shaded room area.
Select that shaded area.
A card opens with the saved name, Briefing room, and its description.
Read the card before relying on a short map label.
The image and the selectable room overlay are separate pieces of
reference information that should agree with the reviewed plan.

visual_required_labels: Fictional team briefing room for this software exercise.

scenes.title: Switch layers and inspect an imported room

captions.text: Select the G I S import tab.
This layer shows two imported region overlays on the floor image.
Select the training-room area to open its saved Training room import details.
Changing a tab changes the layer you are inspecting.
Check the selected blue tab and the opened region’s name together so you
are discussing the intended reference.
Enter Equipment in the search field.
The matching equipment overlay remains while the other region
overlay is filtered out.
The room names printed inside the floor-plan image remain visible
because that image is separate from the searchable overlay.
Select the matching shaded area to open Equipment import and
review its saved description.
Search helps focus the display; it does not change the saved floor drawing.

scenes.title: Clear the search and restore the layer view

captions.text: Close the detail card and remove Equipment from the search field.
Both region overlays return on the G I S import layer.
Clear a search when handing the device to another crew member so the restricted view
is not mistaken for the complete layer.

scenes.title: Review imported KML and KMZ areas

captions.text: Select the K M L and K M Z import tab.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - KML and KMZ import

spoken_references.TRAINING ONLY - KML and KMZ import: K M L and K M Z import

captions.text: This data layer displays the two imported areas over the base map,
without the floor-plan image.
Select each area and read its saved name and description.
The dispatchable area also offers Dispatch to this zone.
This walkthrough reviews the reference cards without submitting a call.
Verify the selected area and your department’s call procedure
before using a dispatch action.

visual_required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - KML and KMZ import

scenes.title: Reopen the map and explain its operational use

captions.text: Return to Maps and reopen the same Indoor Maps entry.
Ground floor and the saved room overlay return in this example.
These are stored reference locations; this viewer does not show who is inside
a room or confirm physical arrival.
Community paramedicine and mental health teams, search-and-rescue crews, security
departments, wildland contractors and industrial response teams can use reviewed
site references alongside fire and E M S.
Keep the map current and verify live-location information separately.
